title: Reincarnated as a Podcaster (Anime/Movie)
author: Reincarnated as a podcaster
description: We talk and review anime, manga, cult classic movies, video games, new releases, fun news in the industry or japan and if there's a garbage movie that is funny because its bad we will review it(so bad its good). Also every so often we review a whole series. We are a very fun group of friends that just love to watch and play to much stuff.
